hero.title: About IZZI Beauty
hero.text: IZZI Beauty is the specialist in permanent makeup and training. With an eye for detail, natural results and personal attention, we help you shine.

story.title: A passion for natural beauty
paragraphs: What began as a passion for natural beauty grew into a renowned studio and academy for permanent makeup.
At IZZI Beauty, everything revolves around quality, hygiene and a natural result that suits you. Our specialists are certified and continually keep up with the latest developments in the field.

values.title: What we stand for
values.text: These principles are at the heart of everything we do.

items.title: Natural result
items.text: We work subtly and to measure, so the result always looks natural.

items.title: Hygiene & safety
items.text: We work to the highest hygiene standards and are GGD-certified (Dutch public health authority).

items.title: Craftsmanship
items.text: Our specialists are certified and keep developing their skills.

items.title: Personal attention
items.text: Every treatment starts with a thorough, personal consultation.

founder.title: Meet the team behind IZZI
paragraphs: With years of experience and a boundless passion for the craft, our team is ready every day to give you the best possible result.
Alongside treatments, we love sharing our knowledge with a new generation of PMU artists through our academy.
